snippet.title: A Castlevania-like with voice acted pixel art cutscenes - Nightstalkers Trailer
snippet.description:
Nightstalkers is a retro action-horror platform with detailed pixel art cutscenes, like the ones seen in the PC-Engine/Turbografx CD and the Sega CD, among other systems, to further the storyline. Set in the 15th century, a female mercenary and a legendary gorgon are set on a dangerous path when Wallachia's former voivode returns with power well beyond the understanding of common humans.

Play it here: https://linktr.ee/nightstalkersgame
